nodes.label: G-code Dialect Template Schema
nodes.rationale: Dialects are format-string templates keyed by operation (laser_on, travel_move, arc_cw, jog, probe_cycle, dwell...) with placeholders the generator fills in ({x_cmd}, {f_command}, {s_command}, {power:.0f}, {machine.active_wcs}). An empty string disables emission of that operation, which is how set_speed and bezier_cubic are switched off everywhere in this chunk. Boolean flags (can_g0_with_speed, omit_unchanged_coords, continuous_laser_mode, modal_feedrate, inject_wcs_after_preamble) steer generator behavior that a template alone cannot express.

nodes.label: M4 Dynamic Laser Power Mode
nodes.rationale: Acmer dialects emit `M4 S{power}` for cutting but `M3 S{power}` for focus. GRBL's M4 scales laser output with actual feed rate, avoiding scorch marks during acceleration and at corners, while M3 holds constant power which is what a stationary focus test needs. These dialects keep modal_feedrate false and pass {f_command} on every G1/G2/G3.
